usage_rules.headings: Use 'Outfit' for all H1-H6. Tracking tight (-0.02em) for H1/H2. Font weight 600 or 700.
usage_rules.body: Use 'Manrope' for all paragraphs, inputs, and labels. Relaxed line-height (1.6).

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');

rules: Never use pure black (#000000). Use #030712 or #0a0a0a.
Primary color (#6366f1) is for main CTAs only.
Use Emerald (#10b981) for 'Match Score' and 'Success' states.
Borders must be subtle: white/10 or white/5.

decorations: Use 'noise' texture overlay at 2% opacity on the main background to reduce digital flatness.
Use 'radial-gradient' glows behind hero images and key dashboard metrics.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 px-6 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_-5px_rgba(99,102,241,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-10 px-6 rounded-lg border border-white/5
buttons.google_auth: bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-100 font-medium flex items-center gap-2 w-full justify-center h-11 rounded-lg

cards.dashboard: bg-gray-900/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-white/20 transition-colors
cards.job_listing: group relative overflow-hidden bg-gray-900/40 border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6 hover:bg-gray-900/60 transition-all hover:border-indigo-500/30

inputs.default: bg-gray-950/50 border-white/10 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-indigo-500/20 rounded-lg h-11

badges.match_score: bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
badges.tag: bg-white/5 text-gray-300 border border-white/5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs

marketing.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8
marketing.rules: Use col-span-full for hero. Use col-span-4 for features. Never fill 100% perfectly; leave breathing room.

dashboard.rules: Sidebar is fixed. Main content uses the grid. Widgets must stretch (h-full).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is Gray-50 or Gray-200 on dark backgrounds. Avoid Gray-500 for body text.

media.image_style: Rounded-xl or Rounded-2xl. Use 'grayscale' on inactive elements, full color on hover (optional).
media.icons: Lucide React (default). Use stroke-width={1.5} for a refined look.

hero_scene.suggestion: Floating abstract particles or a 'network mesh' connecting nodes (representing job matches). Keep it subtle, low poly, and dark-themed.
hero_scene.fallback: High-quality abstract gradient image with noise texture.

charts.style: Line charts with gradients (fill='url(#gradient)'). Tooltips must be dark glassmorphism.

hero_background.description: Abstract blue lines and dots network - represents AI matching and connections.

feature_team.description: Colleagues working on laptops - represents the professional/human side.

feature_abstract.description: Purple cubes hanging - represents structure and building blocks.

office_vibe.description: Modern building corner - represents corporate/enterprise scale.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
